name: Menu Item
structurePatterns: horizontal row: optional leading icon | label (grows) | optional trailing check/metadata
selected shows a check at the trailing edge and brand-colored label
destructive uses danger text/icon but is not a filled red row
destructive group placed last; dividers separate groups (handled by Menu)
usageHints: menu items are contextual actions, not page navigation targets
do not overload one item with icon, badge, description and multiple trailing controls
default action count in a menu is 2-6; destructive item placed last
doNotInvent: no multi-line descriptions in V1 menu item
no cascading submenu as mobile default
